result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. The tests matching `*SalesRep*` and `*PurchaseOrder*` pass. I didn't run the full suite, and I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is one condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, added to the count subquery in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`. That is the same filter the quarterly purchase-order report uses. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
